description: This file is a Java implementation of an Order Data Access Object (DAO) for a sales management system. It handles database operations related to 'Order' entities, including retrieving orders by ID and listing orders based on specific criteria, using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: OrderDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of OrderDao, provides methods to retrieve and list Order entities from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an Order entity by its ID, fetching associated entities like order products, totals, and history.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders for a specific merchant store based on provided criteria, including filtering, sorting, and pagination.
